From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + POC plan next steps

Alex / Priya - great to meet today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps for the 3-week POC we discussed:

1) High-level success criteria (please confirm):
   - Latency: 95th perc < 350ms for our core clinical routing flows
   - Throughput: sustain 120 concurrent sessions during peak
   - Quality: F1 > 0.85 on the 500-sample entity extraction set (your QA team will share labels)
   - Cost: projected $0.08 / 1k tokens at expected throughput

2) Scope & evaluation plan:
   - Week 0 (this week): onboarding, access to a 1000-record sample dataset, and test account setup
   - Week 1: model/quantization config + integration of the prefix caching hook
   - Week 2: load testing and quality sweeps with your QA prompts
   - Week 3: final readout (exec-friendly) and decision window

3) Owners / asks from Coral Health:
   - Alex: provide the 1k sample records and access to a staging API (by end of Thu)
   - Priya: identify 2 reviewers for the evaluation checklist and confirm their availability for final readout
   - Samir (procurement): point of contact for contract/questions afterwards

I attached a draft POC plan and an evaluation checklist - feel free to redline. Proposed final readout slot: Mon 30 Mar, 10:00-10:30 PT (we expect a 20-30 min exec summary + Q&A).

Next step: can you confirm the success criteria above and whether the timeline looks reasonable?

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: CoralHealth_POC_Plan_v1.pdf; CoralHealth_Evaluation_Checklist.xlsx

Thanks Marissa - good recap and thanks for the clear timeline. Confirming on our side:

- Success criteria: agreed on latency and throughput. For quality we need to verify that your eval harness preserves context windows for multi-turn notes; if so the F1 target is OK.
- Data: we'll share the 1k sample set by EOD Thursday.
- Reviewers: Priya will nominate Dr. Emily Chen (Clinical Ops) and Rajiv Menon (Analytics) for the checklist - they're available for the readout window you proposed.
- Procurement: Samir is looped in and will surface any contracting milestones; expect a 2-3 week turnaround post-readout for standard SOW.

One ask: can Marcus Lin be our technical lead during the POC? He can coordinate the integration and run load tests with our infra. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood can run an A/B comparison against our current pipeline (baseline metrics) during Week 2?

Appreciate it - looking forward to getting started.

- Alex
